en.title: Ethiopia receives first Russian Su-35 fighters and plans S-400 purchase, Abiy says
en.summary: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced on October 28 that Ethiopia has received its first Russian Sukhoi Su-35 fighter jets, with a total programme of 12 Su-35s and four S-400 batteries, delivered a year ahead of schedule.
body: Ethiopia has received its first Russian Sukhoi Su-35 fighter jets and plans to acquire Russia's S-400 air defense system, Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced on October 28, 2026, on X while in Moscow for the Russia-Africa Summit. He said Ethiopia will receive 12 Su-35s in total and four S-400 batteries, describing the acquisition as a milestone strengthening national security and deterring aggression in advance. The jets arrived a year ahead of schedule, and Abiy thanked Russian President Vladimir Putin for helping to expedite delivery. He did not disclose the deal's value, when the S-400 systems will arrive, or where the jets and missile batteries will be deployed.

The delivery comes as Ethiopia faces a renewed rebel offensive in the northern Tigray region, launched in September 2026 and reviving the 2020-2022 war, with government forces entering the regional capital Mekelle on October 4, 2026, while fighting continues. Federal troops are also fighting the armed group Fano in the neighbouring Amhara region, and Ethiopia has broken with Eritrea, accusing Eritrea of backing rebels, a charge Eritrea denies. The deepening military relationship with Moscow follows a military cooperation agreement signed in Addis Ababa in July 2021, focused on training and technology for Ethiopia's armed forces, and in January 2026 Janes reported Ethiopia displaying newly acquired Russian Yak-130 advanced jet trainers at an event marking its air force's 90th anniversary. Reporting cited by Aerospace Global News likewise says Abiy stated Ethiopia has received its order for 12 Russian Su-35S air superiority fighters and will also receive Russian S-400 air defence systems later on, with deliveries a year early.

zh.title: 衣索比亞接收首批俄製Su-35戰機、計畫引進S-400防空系統
zh.summary: 衣索比亞總理阿比10月28日宣布，衣索比亞已接收首批俄製蘇愷Su-35戰機，整體計畫共12架Su-35與4組S-400防空飛彈連，交付時間比約定提前一年。
body: 衣索比亞已接收首批俄製蘇愷Su-35戰機，並計畫引進俄羅斯S-400防空系統。總理阿比10月28日在莫斯科出席俄非峰會期間，於X平台宣布這項消息，並表示衣索比亞合計將接收12架Su-35與4組S-400防空飛彈連，形容這是強化國家安全、事先嚇阻侵略的里程碑。戰機交付比約定時程提前一年，阿比感謝俄羅斯總統普丁協助加快交付；他未透露交易金額、S-400系統抵達時間，也未透露戰機與防空飛彈連的部署地點。

這批戰機抵達之際，衣索比亞正面臨北部提格雷地區的新一波叛軍攻勢，該攻勢於2026年9月發動，重新點燃2020年至2022年的戰爭；政府軍已於2026年10月4日進入地區首府默克萊，但戰鬥仍在持續。聯邦部隊也在鄰近的阿姆哈拉地區與武裝團體法諾作戰，衣索比亞已與厄利垂亞斷絕關係，指控厄利垂亞支持叛軍，厄利垂亞否認這項指控。衣索比亞與莫斯科的軍事關係加深，可追溯至2021年7月在阿迪斯阿貝巴簽署的軍事合作協議，重點是衣索比亞武裝部隊的訓練與技術；2026年1月，詹氏防務報導衣索比亞在慶祝空軍90週年的活動中，展示新取得的俄製雅克Yak-130高級教練機。另一家報導同樣指出，阿比表示衣索比亞已接收12架俄製Su-35S空優戰機的訂單，之後還將接收俄製S-400防空系統，且交付提前一年。
